title: •A Jedi’s Cunning
caption: •Somersault (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. While Sidious or an {episode1} hologram on table, opponent may not cancel immunity to attrition of your Jedi and draws no more than two battle destiny at sites where you have a Jedi. Opponent draws no more than two battle destiny where Luke present. {alter}
game_text_lines:
Deploy on table. While Sidious or an {episode1} hologram on
table, opponent may not cancel immunity to attrition of
your Jedi and draws no more than two battle destiny at
sites where you have a Jedi. Opponent draws no more
than two battle destiny where Luke present. {alter}
lore: Luke’s sudden reversal of fortune allowed him to turn the tables on Vader.

notes: COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (756×1099 crop). The slip renames and RETYPES the card: printed Somersault is a LOST INTERRUPT (red Interrupt type disc, destiny 3); the slip prints the green Effect type disc top-left, title '•A Jedi’s Cunning', destiny 5, banner EFFECT (no grabber box). Lore box, Cloud City expansion ring right of the lore box (orange-red sphere) and frame are as printed; art window BLANK white → printed art from the base scan; copyright line not on the slip (stays from printed card; Cloud City 1997 line, '1997' legible on the 350 px scan). Game text: inline black EPISODE I disc before 'hologram' → {episode1}; trailing red circle-slash A → {alter}. No icon column icons; VS17 diamond-17 mark bottom-right of the text box. Banner/text box at the printed card's height (not a tall slip). CHANGES vs Decipher Somersault (CC-L-somersault.gif): title, type disc Interrupt→Effect, destiny 3→5, banner LOST INTERRUPT→EFFECT, game text replaced (printed: 'During a battle at a site, just before drawing battle destiny, if opponent has less than double your total power, use 4 Force to switch your total power with opponent’s. OR If both players just drew one battle destiny, use 1 Force to switch numbers.'); lore unchanged. Lore correction vs wiki: curly apostrophe in Luke’s. No bold in lore. Slip text matches the stub (stub expands [Episode I], 'Immune to Alter'). Base scan only 350 px (no 745 px file on the wiki). Modern: VB5-L-ajediscunning-pre.gif (350 px, Virtual Block 5 reissue). Title apostrophe typed curly as the slip heading prints it.
